SPELL_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal those cards, and put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand. Shuffle your library, then scry 1.

Cherchez dans votre bibliothèque jusqu’à deux cartes de terrain de base, révélez ces cartes et mettez-en une sur le champ de bataille engagée, et l’autre dans votre main. Mélangez votre bibliothèque, puis regard 1.
Busca en tu biblioteca hasta dos cartas de tierra básica, muéstralas, pon una de ellas en el campo de batalla girada y la otra en tu mano. Baraja tu biblioteca, luego adivina 1.

Durchsuche deine Bibliothek nach bis zu zwei Standardland-Karten, zeige sie offen vor, bringe eine davon getappt ins Spiel und nimm die andere auf deine Hand. Mische deine Bibliothek und wende dann Hellsicht 1 an.

Passa in rassegna il tuo grimorio per trovare fino a due carte terra base, rivelale, mettine una sul campo di battaglia TAPpata e aggiungi l’altra alla tua mano. Rimescola il tuo grimorio, poi profetizza 1.
あなたのライブラリーから基本土地カードを最大２枚まで探し、それらを公開し、１枚をタップ状態で戦場に出し、もう１枚をあなたの手札に加える。あなたのライブラリーを切り直し、その後占術１を行う。
당신의 서고에서 기본 대지 카드 두 장을 찾아 공개한다. 그 중 한 장을 탭된 채로 전장에 놓고 나머지 카드는 당신의 손으로 가져간다. 당신의 서고를 섞고 점술 1을 한다.

Найдите в вашей библиотеке не более двух карт базовых земель, покажите те карты и положите одну из них на поле битвы повернутой, а другую — в вашу руку. Перетасуйте вашу библиотеку, затем предскажите 1.
Procure até dois cards de terreno básico em seu grimório, revele-os e coloque um no campo de batalha virado e o outro na sua mão. Embaralhe seu grimório e depois use vidência 1.
从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，展示这些牌，然后将一张横置进战场，另一张则置于你手上。将你的牌库洗牌，然后占卜1。
從你的牌庫中搜尋至多兩張基本地牌，展示這些牌，然後將一張橫置進戰場，另一張則置於你手上。將你的牌庫洗牌，然後占卜1。
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local effectController = EffectController() local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_LAND ) filter:Add( FE_SUPERTYPE, OP_IS, SUPERTYPE_BASIC ) filter:SetZone( ZONE_LIBRARY, effectController) effectController:SetItemCount( 2 ) effectController:SetItemPrompt( 0, "CARD_QUERY_CHOOSE_LAND_TO_PUT_ONTO_THE_BATTLEFIELD_TAPPED" ) effectController:SetItemPrompt( 1, "CARD_QUERY_CHOOSE_LAND_TO_PUT_INTO_HAND" ) effectController:ChooseItems( EffectDC():Make_Targets(0), QUERY_FLAG_UP_TO )
local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(1) if target ~= nil then target:GuidedReveal( target:GetZone(), ZONE_HAND ) end
local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:PutOntoBattlefieldTapped( EffectController() ) end
local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(1) if target ~= nil then target:PutInHand() end

local rep_count = MTG():GetActionRepCount() if rep_count == 0 then ------------------------------- -- 1) ASK FIRST SCRY QUESTION ------------------------------- local scry_value = 1 -- Fill InputDC with top N cards of library local cards_found = 0 local scryDC = EffectDC():Make_Chest(2) local scryInputDC = scryDC:Make_Chest(0) for i=0,scry_value-1 do local card = EffectController():Library_GetNth(i)
if card ~= nil then scryInputDC:Set_CardPtr(cards_found, card)
cards_found = cards_found + 1 end end
if cards_found == 0 then -- No cards in library, end return false end
-- If scrying a single card, multiple choice it if scry_value == 1 or cards_found == 1 then local effectController = EffectController() if effectController ~= nil then effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_TOP" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_BOTTOM", TRANSITION_BOTTOM_OF_LIBRARY ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_QUESTION", EffectController():Library_GetTop() ) end return true end local scryTopDC = scryDC:Make_Chest(1)
-- If scrying more than 1 card, we need a browser if cards_found > 1 then -- Ask query EffectController():SetItemCount( cards_found )
for i=0,cards_found-1 do EffectController():SetItemPrompt( i, "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE" ) end
EffectController():ChooseItemsFromDC( scryInputDC, scryTopDC, QUERY_FLAG_UP_TO + QUERY_FLAG_ORDERED_SELECTION ) end return true elseif rep_count == 1 then ------------------------------- -- 2) MOVE THE CARDS ------------------------------- local scryDC = EffectDC():Get_Chest(2) -- Get old chests, and determine actual scry value local scryInputDC = scryDC:Get_Chest(0) local scry_value = scryInputDC:Count() if scry_value == 1 then local answer = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if answer == 0 then -- Scryed the single top card to top, nothing to do end if answer == 1 then -- Scry the top card to the bottom scryInputDC:Get_CardPtr(0):PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end else
local scryTopDC = scryDC:Get_Chest(1) local scry_top = scryTopDC:Count() if scry_value > 1 and scry_top < scry_value then -- Fill SecondInputDC with everything in InputDC not in TopDC ("what's left") for i=0,scry_value-1 do local card = scryInputDC:Get_CardPtr(i)
for j=0,scry_top-1 do if card == scryTopDC:Get_CardPtr(j) then -- chosen, ignore card = nil break end end
-- if not present in TopDC, move it to the bottom if card ~= nil then card:PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end end
-- Move chosen cards to top of library so first -- card chosen ends up on top of the library for i=0,scry_top-1 do local card = scryTopDC:Get_CardPtr(i)
if card ~= nil then card:PutOnTopOfLibrary() end end end end -- END return false end
